caseNameFull: NATIONAL LABOR RELATIONS BOARD v. Noel CANNING

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit granted. In addition to the questions presented by the *2862petition, the parties are directed to brief and argue the following question: Whether the President's recess-appointment power may be exercised when the Senate is convening every three days in pro forma sessions.
